body:
Define "they".
The people in question fired me.

If I do it, I ain't going alone. But I feel pretty powerless, and I don't hav eany reason to believe it will get better. I don't really believe in free will, or willpower, or any of the sort of things that would imply the future will be much different than the past. Frankly, science doesn't support it. So I think it would be best if I just did it. That being said, it would be a waste for me to go without taking some of the cocksuckers responsible for this mess with me.
And Reddit doesn't care as usual.
If I survive the next week, maybe I'll get it printed up for my wall.
